messages:
Sasha Ribeiro: quick share — ran int4-nf4 bringup for model v2.3 with prefix-KV caching toggled. short summary: latency -22% p50, cost -31% token cost, but instruction-evals show hallucination indicator up +1.8% abs on eval-suite-v3. putting proposed canary gate below, want opinions before I wire it into the rollout pipeline.
Alex Kim: what metric exactly is the +1.8%? which signal are we tracking?
Sasha Ribeiro: it’s the 'hallucination_rate' from our eval harness (binary halluc detection + human-verified sample). baseline v2.2 = 3.1%, int4 run = 4.9%. sample size ~6k prompts.
Maya Patel: 1.8% absolute is nontrivial. our usual tolerances are 1.0% abs or 30% relative, whichever is smaller. that would trigger rollback by policy.
Dave Chen: also check callee-level regressions — some routes (summarize-doc) spike more. we need route-scoped gates, not just global.
infra-ops: agree. KV prefix mismatch was suspected — when caching is on, some prefix tokens are stale for long tails. if mismatch_rate > 0.5% we should auto-fallback that route.
Sasha Ribeiro: noted — route breakdown attached in logs. top offenders: summarize-doc (2.6% delta), code-assist (0.4%), chat (0.6%). overall 1.8% weighted.
Alex Kim: propose canary config: staged traffic [1%, 5%, 25%] with hold windows [30m, 2h, 6h]. automatic rollback if any of: delta(hallucination_rate) > 1.0% abs AND pvalue < 0.05 during hold window, OR route_specific_delta > 1.5% on >5% of traffic for that route.
Maya Patel: add hysteresis: require sustained signal for at least 15 minutes and a 2-sample confirmation from eval webhook. else mark as flaky.
Sasha Ribeiro: here's the JSON I plan to feed into rollout service (minus secrets):
```json
{"canary": {"steps": [1,5,25], "holds_minutes": [30,120,360], "metrics": [{"name": "hallucination_rate", "threshold_abs": 0.01, "comparison": "greater"}, {"name": "prefix_mismatch_rate", "threshold_abs": 0.005, "comparison": "greater", "scope": "route"}], "rollback_logic": "if any metric crosses threshold with pvalue<0.05 and sustained >=15m -> rollback to previous stable"}}
```
Dave Chen: +1 for route-scope. also include a soft-fallback path: when prefix_mismatch_rate > 0.5% for route X, temporarily disable caching for that route rather than full model rollback. reduces blast radius.
Alex Kim: good idea — add a 'fallback_action' enum per metric: [disable_cache, switch-variant, full-rollback]. default for prefix_mismatch_rate = disable_cache. default for hallucination_rate = switch-variant (int8) then rollback if persists.
infra-ops: operational note: switching to int8 variant must be transactional — KV cache layout changes, keep cache migration idempotent. plan for cache version tag in responses.
Sasha Ribeiro: updated config with actions and variants. also adding a guard: never escalate more than one action per 5m to avoid thrash.
deploy-bot: deploying canary per requested config to route=@summarize-doc at 2% starting now. commit id: d7b9ef.
ci-bot: smoke checks: tokenization parity OK, memory footprint within expected bounds, 3/3 unit smoke tests passed.
Maya Patel: run an A/B shadow comparison for next 1h with traffic mirrored for metrics collection (no user-visible switch) — helps estimate pvalue quicker.
Sasha Ribeiro: started shadow run at 2165432130. will post interim after 30m.
Alex Kim: one more ask — add alerting to SLO dashboard for 'relative_latency_increase > 10%' in case quant brings tail regressions. sometimes p50 ok but p99 spikes.
Dave Chen: logging: include 'cache_miss_id' in traces so we can correlate prefix miss patterns to users/app versions.
Sasha Ribeiro: noted. interim update after 30m: shadow traffic ~120k requests, hallucination delta now +1.6% (pvalue 0.03) weighted, summarize-doc route still ~2.4% delta. prefix_mismatch_rate for summarize-doc = 0.82%.
Maya Patel: that crosses our prefix_mismatch threshold and hallucination threshold. proceed with soft-fallback: disable cache for summarize-doc and hold canary at current traffic.
deploy-bot: applied fallback action: disable_cache route=summarize-doc at 2165432140.
ci-bot: post-action smoke: summarize-doc latency +8% p50, hallucination delta reduced to +0.9% (now within tolerance).
Alex Kim: looks like cache was interacting badly with quantized weights. recommend we default to disable cache for summarize-doc on int4 until further investigation.
Sasha Ribeiro: agree. plan: revert auto-promotion for v2.3 int4 on summarize-doc, continue limited canary on chat/code-assist routes where metrics are OK, open follow-up ticket to debug KV layout + quant interaction.
Maya Patel: create ticket with eval snippets and 50 sample cases for human review. assign to Sasha + Dave.
Sasha Ribeiro: created ticket INF-4642 with attachments. thanks all. :thumbsup:
